definitions.explanation: To look into something carefully to find information or the truth.
To search for information in a reference source like a dictionary or the internet.

examples.japanese: {原因|げんいん}を{調|しら}べる。
{警察|けいさつ}が{事件|じけん}を{調|しら}べている。
examples.english: The police are investigating the case.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}に{体|からだ}を{調|しら}べてもらった。
examples.english: I had the doctor examine me.

examples.japanese: {辞書|じしょ}で{言葉|ことば}を{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: Look up a word in the dictionary.

examples.japanese: インターネットで{調|しら}べてみます。
examples.english: I'll look it up on the internet.

examples.japanese: {地図|ちず}で{道|みち}を{調|しら}べてから{出|で}かけた。
examples.english: I checked the route on a map before heading out.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{調|しら}べる (investigate/look up X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {調|しら}べている = 'is investigating/looking up.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{辞書|じしょ}で{調|しら}べる (look up in a dictionary)
・ネットで{調|しら}べる (search online)
・{原因|げんいん}を{調|しら}べる (investigate the cause)
・よく{調|しら}べる (examine carefully)
・{調|しら}べてみる (try looking up)

USAGE CONTEXTS:
・Academic research
・Police investigations
・Looking things up in dictionaries/online
・Checking facts

RELATED:
・{調査|ちょうさ} (investigation, survey—noun, more formal)
・{検索|けんさく} (search—especially computer searches)
